ios.desc:
Get ready for a brain-busting adventure with Sudoku Puzzle Palace! With unlimited puzzles, you'll never run out of challenges. 

Unleash your sudoku skills with Sudoku Puzzle Palace! In less than two taps, you'll be playing sudoku immediately, without any extra frills. 

The app requires minimal space on your phone, has unobtrusive permission requirements, and never collects any personal information. The sleek and well-thought-out design is focused solely on gameplay, making it the perfect app for all ages, from beginners to advanced sudoku players.

Challenge yourself with unlimited sudoku puzzles at four levels of difficulty - you never run out of boards to play with. Sudoku Puzzle Palace offers a productive way to spend your time and keep your mind active. If you get stuck while playing, you can request a hint to have a box filled in and receive the extra nudge you need to keep going.

Download today and let the solving begin!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Sudoku with 0 Bells or Whistles

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I've created a new Sudoku app for iOS and Android that prioritizes simplicity and privacy. It's free to download and use, and I'd be grateful for any feedback or suggestions.

Features:

> 4 difficulty levels, accessible at any time

> No personal data collection of any kind

> Clean, minimalistic design that focuses on the game

> Takes up significantly less space than other popular apps (by a factor of about 10x)

> Minimal use of advertisements

I was frustrated by how many of the popular Sudoku apps feel excessively over-engineered, consume a lot of storage space and some that even collect unnecessary personal information, like location and contacts. So I put this app together without any of those things (using flutter).

Links:

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/sudoku-puzzle-palace/id1668683822

android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kingfishertech.sudoku

Here's a screenshot of the main app page: https://imgur.com/a/FbCf2IJ

Thanks for taking a look and happy solving!
